meta.gate_note: 채널 오버라이드 게이트 A(얼굴)·B(원 단위 금액)·C(사건 진행중)·D(주어=내 돈)를 9장 전부 통과. 소재에 실존 유명인이 없어 §2-A ②「나 같은 사람」(50~60대, 65세+·특수직업·성공자 제외)으로 통일. 🔍 확대 콜아웃은 쓰지 않았다 — 게이트 A가 9장 전부에 얼굴 55~60%를 요구하는데 콜아웃은 「인물 표정이 주인공인 장면 금지」라 정면 충돌하므로, 금액은 전부 「원래 큰 것」(안내 모니터·전광 안내판·현수막·창구 게시판)에 크게 얹었다.
meta.gate_note_2: 7~9번은 주 레퍼 001(633,252회·92.8배) 프레임 계승 — 인물 없는 고층 통유리 공간. 앵커 005(5,115회) 계승분은 폐기됨(2026-08-21).
meta.prompt_suffix: Style: candid documentary photograph of a real place, not an advertisement, not CGI, not a composite. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at about f/2.8, standing eye level, available light only, true-to-life restrained colour, mild sensor noise, a slight handheld tilt, honest texture on skin, wood, glass and metal. The overall image stays natural — never glowing, never hyper-saturated, no HDR look, no rim-light effects, no lens flare; the only things allowed to look bright are real screens and backlit information boards that are physically present in the room. Apart from the Korean words and figures quoted above, every other surface — posters, leaflets, forms, name badges and background signage — carries only entries printed too small and slightly out of focus to read; do not invent any other Korean words, no English text, no Latin letters, no fake Chinese characters, no gibberish lettering, no random numbers. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark, no graphic arrows, no highlight circles, no drawn effects of any kind.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「이자가 한 칸 넘는 순간 화면이 초록에서 빨강으로 넘어간다」 — 파트③ 금융소득종합과세 기준선 2,000만원(14년째 불변)이 근거. [A 얼굴] 나 같은 사람(50대 후반 월급쟁이) / [B 금액] "1,999만원" · "2,001만원" / [C 사건] 오른쪽 화면이 지금 빨강으로 넘어가는 중 / [D 주어] 2만원 차이로 내 이자가 선을 넘는다 / [구도] 좌우대비 / [텍스트] 제목「20만 원 더 벌고 수백만 원 냅니다」는 결과, 썸네일은 경계선 자체 — 정보가 다르다
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark shoulders and back of the man nearest the camera together with the shadowed front panel of the waiting-area bench, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, hand, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. Counters and table tops run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge, and anything resting on them sits at mid height. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the man is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right. The bank staff behind the counter are far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Scene: photographed inside an ordinary Korean bank branch, camera at standing eye level in the customer waiting area, looking straight ahead. Across the left two thirds of the frame two large customer information screens are mounted side by side on a wood-panelled wall at mid height, and a floor-to-ceiling glass partition with a slim aluminium post runs vertically between them, splitting that side of the picture into two halves. The left screen is calm and cool green: a small header reading "금융소득" in Korean Hangul sits above very large clean white digits reading "1,999만원" that fill most of the panel width. The right screen is in the act of flipping over — its panel has just gone saturated red, the same header "금융소득" in Korean Hangul above very large white digits reading "2,001만원", the refresh line still halfway down the glass. Fluorescent ceiling tubes and daylight from the street window mix over the teller counters behind, where deposit slips and a pen on a chain sit at mid height. In the right third stands a South Korean man in his late fifties in a navy zip-up jacket, seen chest-up, facing the camera: one eyebrow pulled high and the other pressed low, eyes wide and just flicking back from the red screen, lips parted in the middle of a word, one hand raised to chest height still pinching the corner of the deposit slip he was holding.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「10억을 예금에 넣으면 매달 225만 6,000원이 들어온다 — 그리고 그 순간 기준선을 넘는다」. verified-data 3절(예금 연 3.2% → 월 225만 6,000원)과 4절(연 2,000만원 초과)이 근거. [A 얼굴] 나 같은 사람(60대 초반, 은퇴 앞둔 보통 가정) / [B 금액] "월 225만 6,000원" · "2,000만원" / [C 사건] 프린터에서 명세가 반쯤 나오는 중, 직원 손이 숫자를 짚는 중 / [D 주어] 저 화면에 뜬 게 내 이자다 / [구도] 화면 클로즈업 / [텍스트] 제목은 「얼마를 내는가」, 썸네일은 「얼마가 들어오는가」

No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, hand, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The teller behind the counter is far smaller, roughly one third of her head height and cropped so that only an arm and a shoulder show. Scene: photographed at a Korean bank teller window, camera at seated eye level. Filling the right two thirds of the frame, a large customer-facing monitor has been swivelled around towards us and stands upright at mid height on the counter: a small header reading "이자 지급" in Korean Hangul sits above enormous clean white digits reading "월 225만 6,000원" that run almost the whole width of the screen, and below them a short saturated red line reads "2,000만원". The teller's hand, in a dark sleeve and with no face visible, is in the act of tapping the big number with one fingertip, and beside the monitor a small receipt printer is halfway through pushing a printed slip out into the air. Glass partition, wood counter front, a pen on a chain, and a small stack of forms sit at mid height under mixed fluorescent light and daylight. In the left third, a South Korean woman in her early sixties in a beige knit cardigan, seen chest-up, faces the camera with her brows drawn together, eyes wide and fixed on us rather than on the screen, lips pressed into a tight line, and one hand stopped in mid-air beside her cheek.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「해마다 이 줄이 길어지고 있다 — 기준선은 14년째 그대로인데」. verified-data 4절(대상자 2006년 3만 5,924명 → 2024년 43만 5,380명, 전년비 +29.5%)이 근거. thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 다 도달한 자리의 전망이 창 하나 너머에 펼쳐져 있는데, 정작 그 앞은 사람 없이 비어 있고 협탁에 계산서 한 장만 놓여 있다 / [남김] 그 한 줄 모순 · 세로 창틀이 화면을 여러 칸으로 가르는 분할선과 실내·창밖의 경계 · 카메라는 거실 안쪽에 앉은 눈높이로 창을 정면으로 본다 · 인물 0명 + 통유리와 야경이 상단 5/8을 가로로 꽉 채우는 배치, 실내 따뜻한 간접조명 vs 창밖 차가운 도시광의 색온도 대비 / [바꿈] 공간의 성격(과시적 펜트하우스 → 현실적으로 닿는 고층 아파트 거실, 평범한 마감) · 화면 안 사물(없음 → 창가 협탁 위 방금 뜯긴 11월 우편물) · 관찰 디테일(연출된 장식 → 소파 팔걸이에 걸친 낡은 카디건과 식은 찻잔) ※ 카메라 시점은 바꾸지 않았다. [A 얼굴] ⛔ 없음 — 001 프레임 재현이 목적이라 의도적으로 §2-A를 비켜 간다(gate_note_2) / [B 금액] ⛔ 없음 — 동일 사유. 통보문 헤더 "자격상실 안내"만 / [C 사건] 봉투가 방금 뜯겨 통보문이 반쯤 빠져나와 말려 올라가는 중, 커튼이 들리는 중 / [D 주어] 저 전망도 저 우편물도 내 것이다 / [구도] 인물 없는 공간 단독 / [텍스트] 001 배치 계승 — 하단 2단, 윗줄 노랑 "20만 원 더 벌었습니다" / 아랫줄 흰색 11월의 계산서
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark back and arm of the sofa nearest the camera together with the shadowed floor in front of it, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No screen, no lamp and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — the window wall, the city view and every object of interest sit in the upper five-eighths. The side table top runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge, and anything resting on it sits at mid height. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: there is no person anywhere in this picture — no figure, no silhouette, no face, no hands, and no reflection of a person in the glass. The full-height window wall and the city beyond it are the largest thing in the frame, running edge to edge across the entire upper five-eighths, with slim dark vertical mullions dividing that span into tall panels; the furniture at the left and right edges is far smaller and only frames the view. Scene: photographed from inside the living room of an ordinary high-floor Korean apartment, camera at seated eye level, square on to the glass and looking straight out. Beyond the window a wide river bends through a dense city at dusk — the sky still holds orange and violet low over distant hills while the bridges, apartment blocks and one tall tower below have already switched on and read as cold white and blue points of light. Inside, a recessed cove light runs along the ceiling and washes the plain plaster in warm amber, a low bookshelf holds the right edge and a leafy potted plant the left; the finishes are modest — painted walls, a simple fabric sofa, ordinary flooring, lived in rather than staged. A small wooden side table stands against the glass at mid height, and on it a white window envelope has just been torn open with the notice sheet pulled halfway out and still curling upward, its header reading "자격상실 안내" in Korean Hangul while the smaller lines beneath are printed too small and slightly out of focus to read; the sheer curtain beside it is lifting in a draught and the corner of the paper is rising with it. A worn cardigan hangs over the arm of the sofa, and a half-finished cup of tea and a pair of reading glasses sit beside the envelope. The room is completely empty of people.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 도달한 자의 전망을 등지고, 그 앞 탁자 위에서는 계산이 이미 켜져 돌아가고 있다 / [남김] 그 한 줄 모순 · 세로 창틀 분할선과 실내·창밖 경계 · 카메라는 거실 안쪽에서 창을 정면으로 본다 · 인물 0명 + 통유리와 야경이 상단 5/8을 채우는 배치와 실내 따뜻함 vs 창밖 차가움 대비 / [바꿈] 피사체(창밖 야경 → 창가 콘솔 위 실물 서류·화면이 전경 주인공, 야경은 초점 밖으로 물러남) · 화면 안 사물(없음 → 노트북 화면의 연 이자 금액과 벽걸이 11월 달력) · 시간대와 광원(해질녘 블루아워 → 늦은 밤, 스탠드 하나와 화면 백라이트만) ※ 카메라 시점은 바꾸지 않았다. [A 얼굴] ⛔ 없음(001 프레임 재현) / [B 금액] ⭕ "3,200만원" · "2,000만원" — 이 장으로 §2-B를 통과시킨다 / [C 사건] 화면 숫자의 마지막 자리가 지금 갱신되는 중, 달력 장이 반쯤 넘어가 들려 있는 중 / [D 주어] 저 연 이자가 내 것이고 그게 선을 넘겼다 / [구도] 인물 없는 공간 단독 / [텍스트] 001 배치 계승 — 하단 2단, 윗줄 노랑 / 아랫줄 흰색
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark near edge of the console table and the shadowed floor below it, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No screen, no lamp and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every screen, sheet of paper and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The console top runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge, and everything resting on it sits at mid height. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: there is no person anywhere in this picture — no figure, no silhouette, no face, no hands, and no reflection of a person in the glass. The full-height window wall and the night city beyond it still run edge to edge across the entire upper five-eighths behind everything, divided into tall panels by slim dark vertical mullions, but they are held slightly soft in focus; the laptop screen on the console is the sharpest thing in the frame and fills about a third of the picture width. Scene: photographed from inside the living room of an ordinary high-floor Korean apartment late at night, camera at seated eye level, square on to the glass and looking straight out over a long console table pushed against the window. Beyond the glass the sunset colours are gone and only the cold white and blue lights of the city, its bridges and one tall tower remain. Inside, a single floor lamp in the right corner throws warm amber across the plain plaster wall, and the laptop standing open on the console casts its own light onto the papers around it. The laptop screen is turned towards the camera: a header reading "연 이자" in Korean Hangul sits above enormous clean white digits reading "3,200만원" running almost the whole width of the screen, with a short saturated red line beneath reading "2,000만원", and the last digit of the big figure is still mid-refresh. Beside it on the wall hangs a large paper calendar whose sheet reads "11월" in Korean Hangul in very large characters, the sheet half turned and lifted away from the wall, the date squares below too small and slightly out of focus to read. Bank statements, a torn window envelope, reading glasses and a cold cup sit at mid height on the console. The room is completely empty of people.

[A 얼굴] ⛔ 없음(001 프레임 재현) / [B 금액] ⛔ 없음 — 고지서 헤더 "11월 고지서"만. 11번이 §2-B를 대신 통과한다 / [C 사건] 좌측 다운라이트가 방금 꺼지며 잔광이 스러지는 중, 고지서 맨 위 장이 협탁 끝에서 미끄러져 떨어지려는 중 / [D 주어] 어느 쪽 거실에 내가 앉게 되는가 / [구도] 인물 없는 공간 단독 + 좌우대비 / [텍스트] 001 배치 계승 — 하단 2단, 윗줄 노랑 / 아랫줄 흰색
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark backs of the two low sofas nearest the camera and the shadowed floor between them, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No lamp, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — the window wall, both side tables and every object of interest sit in the upper five-eighths. The side table tops run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge, and anything resting on them sits at mid height. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: there is no person anywhere in this picture — no figure, no silhouette, no face, no hands, and no reflection of a person in the glass. The full-height window wall and the night city beyond it are the largest thing in the frame, running edge to edge across the entire upper five-eighths and divided into tall panels by slim dark vertical mullions; a thick square structural pillar stands at the centre of that span and cuts the room into a left half and a right half. Scene: photographed from inside the living room of an ordinary high-floor Korean apartment, camera at seated eye level, square on to the glass and looking straight out; the same river, the same bridges and the same tall lit tower run continuously across both halves of the window so it is clearly one view. The left half of the room has just gone dark — its cove lighting is switched off with the last warm glow still dying out of the bulb, the curtain half drawn, and only cold blue city light reaching in; on the left side table a leaning stack of window envelopes and printed bills sits at mid height, the top sheet already sliding off the edge, its header reading "11월 고지서" in Korean Hangul while the smaller lines beneath are printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. The right half is still warm and alive — recessed amber cove light along the ceiling, a lit floor lamp, a bookshelf, and on the right side table a bankbook squared up beside a steaming cup. Warm amber on the right, cold blue on the left, and the same dusk city outside both. The room is completely empty of people.
